messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads up — Lumenix private deployment is blocked on two items: (1) cross-account VPC peering + route tables, (2) customer wants a KMS key with a specific key policy for a third-party auditor. Their renewal exec check is Friday. If we don't clear this week, AM flagged it as at-risk.
Liam (Network): Looking now. Can you paste their VPC CIDR and the target subnet IDs? Also need the peering acceptance IAM role.
Maya (Lumenix): CIDR: 10.48.0.0/16, target subnets: subnet-0a1b2c3d, subnet-0f2e3d4c. We do NOT want transitive routing through prod.
Carlos (Solutions Eng): For peering, we'll do cross-account peering with explicit route entries. @Liam suggest adding this route table entry on our side once peering is active:
```
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-1234abcd --destination-cidr-block 10.48.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0a1b2c3
```
Priya (Security): Draft KMS key policy below — note we must allow CloudTrail to use the key for log encryption and give the auditor role limited decrypt/generate permissions (no key deletion or management):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/external-audit"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"kms:Encrypt","Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Maya (Lumenix): Confirming auditor role ARN is arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/external-audit. Also need audit log retention to 365 days per our compliance.
Aisha (CS): AM already looped in and flagged Renewal-at-Risk. Can we do a preflight call tomorrow 10:00 AM PT? Need clear owners for peering, KMS, and CloudTrail so I can update the renewal owner.
deploy-bot: Preflight checklist created: https://internal.redwood/meet/1845003210 — items: VPC peering, route tables, IAM role trust verification, KMS key policy, CloudTrail -> S3 with encryption, 365d retention and lifecycle rule.
Liam (Network): I can create the peering and route entries today. Will post the peering ID and an acceptance command for Lumenix to run.
Priya (Security): I'll finalize the KMS policy and include a condition to limit usage to the auditor role and cloudtrail principal. Will post the final policy by EOD.
Carlos (Solutions Eng): I'll wire up CloudTrail to the encrypted S3 bucket and add lifecycle rule to keep logs for 365 days. Scheduling a test ingest at 3:00 PM PT.
Maya (Lumenix): Thanks everyone — 10:00 AM PT preflight works for us. Really appreciate the fast turnaround. :rocket:
Aisha (CS): Great — I'll send the invite and include AM + renewal owner. If we clear these items before Friday, we should be able to remove the renewal risk flag.
